item.title: BYD leads China EV selloff: Weak January sales
item.description: SHENZHEN: BYD Co led a selloff of Chinese electric vehicle makers in Hong Kong on Monday, after soft January sales figures signaled demand is cooling in the world’s biggest auto market. item.title: One in 10 cars sold in Europe made by a Chinese brand
item.description: PARIS: Chinese automakers built nearly one in 10 passenger cars sold in Europe last month, a record share that caps a year of rapid growth led by brisk sales of hybrid and battery-powered vehicles.
